#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Estimate per-module cost from a timestamped `lake build` log plus the import DAG.

Lake buffers a job's output and prints it at completion, so job *start* times are not
in the log.  But a module cannot start before all of its project dependencies have
finished, so

    cost(M) >= end(M) - max(end(D) for D in project deps of M)

is an upper bound that becomes tight exactly when a worker was free — which is the
case for the long serial tail, i.e. for the modules that actually matter.
"""
import os
import re
import sys

log = sys.argv[1]
srcroot = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else "AlgebraicJacobian"

end, t0 = {}, None
with open(log, errors="replace") as fh:
    for line in fh:
        ts, _, txt = line.partition("|")
        try:
            t = float(ts)
        except ValueError:
            continue
        if t0 is None:
            t0 = t
        m = re.search(r"\] Built (AlgebraicJacobian\S*)", txt)
        if m:
            end[m.group(1)] = t - t0

imports = {}
for dirpath, _, filenames in os.walk(srcroot):
    for fn in filenames:
        if not fn.endswith(".lean"):
            continue
        p = os.path.join(dirpath, fn)
        name = p[:-5].replace("/", ".")
        deps = []
        for line in open(p, errors="replace"):
            m = re.match(r"^import\s+(AlgebraicJacobian\.[A-Za-z0-9_.]+)", line)
            if m:
                deps.append(m.group(1))
        imports[name] = deps

rows = []
for mod, e in end.items():
    deps = [end[d] for d in imports.get(mod, []) if d in end]
    rows.append((e - max(deps + [0.0]), e, mod))
rows.sort(reverse=True)

wall = max(end.values()) if end else 0
print(f"modules built: {len(end)}   last completion: {wall:.0f}s ({wall/60:.1f} min)")
print(f"{'cost<=':>8} {'done@':>7}  module")
for c, e, mod in rows[:30]:
    print(f"{c:8.0f} {e:7.0f}  {mod}")
